tools.name: list_personas
tools.description: List free CastMyAgent persona packs. Optionally filter by department. Returns slug, name, role, department, a short summary, and the roster URL.

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Load one free persona pack by slug. Returns the production system prompt, the character brief, and the style configuration. The pack is free and the text is MIT licensed.

tools.name: search_personas
tools.description: Find free persona packs by keyword. Matches the role and specialties.
